name: Vilarmaior (Spain)
description: Green field with a yellow bend from the upper hoist to the lower fly charged with three red crosses patée, between six yellow annulets.
history: Municipal flag of Vilarmaior; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: bend from the upper hoist to the lower fly
three crosses patée on the bend
six annulets, three on each side of the bend
